sources.scope: 本課「兩奈米以下製程架構」的延伸背景。原子尺度沉積與蝕刻的背景導覽；細部機制以另列的課程技術來源查證。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。

videos.title: Lam：原子尺度工程時代
watchFor: 沉積增加材料、蝕刻選擇性移除材料，兩者需要搭配。
原子層操作著重循環控制；不可把每一循環必定等於完整原子層。
高深寬比及三維結構使均勻性與選擇性同時重要。
watchForEn: Deposition adds material while etching removes selected material; the processes work together.
Atomic-layer methods use controlled cycles; do not assume every cycle necessarily equals one complete atomic layer.
High-aspect-ratio and 3D features make both uniformity and selectivity important.

videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and translations depend on the source platform. The bilingual points are original academy guides based on official descriptions, not a transcript or timestamped account.
videos.before: 先問：「晶相與鐵電性：建立模型」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Phase and ferroelectricity: construct and analyze requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「氧交換介面：建立模型」列為查證任務：改變氧環境可能同時改變晶相和缺陷；氧移動可能伴隨循環歷史效應。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Oxygen-exchange interfaces: construct and analyze: Oxygen conditions can alter both phase and defects; Oxygen migration can depend on cycling history.

courses.overview: 從「鐵電記憶體氧化鉿薄膜」延伸比較高介電常數原子層沉積、電荷捕捉記憶體閘極工程：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Hafnia thin films for ferroelectric memory by comparing High-k atomic layer deposition and Charge-trap memory gate engineering: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: HZO 與一般高介電膜都依賴薄膜厚度、界面與後續熱歷史；成膜品質需對應電性。
related.transferEn: HZO and conventional high-k films both depend on thickness, interfaces and thermal history, linking deposition quality to electrical behavior.
related.difference: 高介電材料不必具有鐵電性；HZO 的相組成、喚醒與疲勞不能由高 κ 或膜厚單獨證明。
related.differenceEn: A high-k material need not be ferroelectric; HZO phase, wake-up and fatigue cannot be proven by high kappa or thickness alone.
practice: 分開高介電常數與可切換極化兩項需求。
將熱史、相證據與循環電性放入同表。
比較介面層對電容與切換窗口的影響。
practiceEn: Separate high permittivity from switchable polarization requirements.
Tabulate thermal history, phase evidence and cycling behavior.
Compare interface effects on capacitance and switching windows.
related.title: 高介電常數原子層沉積

related.why: HZO 與一般高介電膜都依賴薄膜厚度、界面與後續熱歷史；成膜品質需對應電性。
related.whyEn: HZO and conventional high-k films both depend on thickness, interfaces and thermal history, linking deposition quality to electrical behavior.

related.transfer: 兩者都以閘堆疊的內部狀態改變讀取電性，需同時比較窗口、保持與耐久。
related.transferEn: Both modify readout through an internal gate-stack state, requiring window, retention and endurance comparisons.
related.difference: 電荷捕捉依賴載子陷阱；鐵電依賴可切換極化。相似遲滯窗口不能證明相同機制或相同寫入條件。
related.differenceEn: Charge trapping relies on carrier traps; ferroelectrics rely on switchable polarization. Similar hysteresis does not prove identical mechanisms or programming conditions.
practice: 畫陷阱電荷與極化方向兩種狀態圖。
比較保持漂移與循環退化的觀察量。
提出能區分捕捉效應與鐵電切換的量測。
practiceEn: Draw separate trapped-charge and polarization-state diagrams.
Compare observables for retention drift and cycling degradation.
Propose measurements distinguishing trapping from ferroelectric switching.
related.title: 電荷捕捉記憶體閘極工程

courses.summary: 本課以「imec 魯汶研究園區（Tower 代表點）」作為公開研究、量測或產業歷史的代表地點。從晶相與鐵電性、摻雜與比例到整合證據：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。 技術由多個地區、企業與研究團隊共同發展；地圖不是唯一發明地，也不是未公開生產設施定位。
courses.summaryEn: This course uses imec Leuven research campus: Tower reference as a public research, metrology or industrial-history reference. From Phase and ferroelectricity and Dopants and composition to Integration evidence: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages. Multiple regions and institutions develop these technologies; the map is neither an exclusive invention claim nor undisclosed production coordinates.
